supersedes.reason: independent audit S8: missing comparison arms, execution rules, total budget and fixed predictions

purpose: G-15 at the critic counterexample-search application point: whether structured micro-lenses change grounded new counterexamples, missed defects, false rejections and joint errors, compared under identical conditions.

application_point.note: Only this point varies, so only its contribution may be reported.

precondition: The no-lens configuration of the critic has passed release-v2 qualification on its own sealed set; lens arms are then compared on a further sealed set not used for qualification.

arms.definition: the critic's standard review with its full default counterexample-proposal path, same max_proposed_chains
arms.note: recorded as a duplicate of no_lens if identical

arms.definition: counterexample-proposal path retained, same max_proposed_chains, lens text absent
a generic multi-perspective checklist with the same exploration budget as the lens arms
constructs from actual user work cases
arms.note: no actual user constructs exist; none are invented

held_equal: evaluator, verifier, judge and independence profile
total generation + review + completion + execution budget per arm
predictions_fixed_in_advance: each lens arm's expected distinguishing questions and the defects it predicts to surface are recorded in the run record before the first dispatch
execution: inherits release-v2 execution and acceptance.incomplete: 3 repetitions per case, no retry, no fallback, concurrency 1, one run per sealed set, authority and spend recorded
measurements: per case and arm: verifier verdict and boundary class
grounded new counterexamples (valid and citing materials) per arm
misses, false rejections, abstentions and same-item joint errors per arm, real denominators
paired differences of each arm against no_lens and against strong_existing_procedure on the same case
calls, tokens, spend, wall time and human review burden per arm (a subscription is not cost zero)
information-gain effect (new evidence found) separated from interpretation effect
reporting: observed counts and paired differences with every invalid trial listed; source fidelity, question-trace presence, actual added effect and generalization scope reported separately; no effect, a worse effect or a narrower scope is a valid result
never_claimed: that a lens improves the critic in general
effects at the other two application points
